[[Brave Brent Poltroon]] is a member of the [[Ebon Vanguard]] squad commanded by [[Sergeant Weststar]]. 

==Locations==
*[[Charr Homelands]]
**{{NPC location|Grothmar Wardowns}} (once, before [[Falling Out]])

==Missions==
*[[Ascalon]]
**{{NPC location|The Flight North}}

==Dialogue==
:''After I die gloriously in battle, the bards will compose songs of my bravery and derring-do. But I don't plan on dying for a long, long time. I can't go before I think of a few stanzas that rhyme with my name.''

==Notes==
* After this Level 20 Ranger dies, [[Corpse of Brave Brent Poltroon|his Corpse]] can be found in [[Dalada Uplands]] (however, it is only Level 1 and holds a [[hammer]]).

== Trivia ==
* "Poltroon" is slang term for a cowardly person.
